title: Pistachio, Pink Peppercorn, and Currant Bark
description: Chocolate bark gets a Christmas makeover by using only red and green ingredients: chopped pistachios, red peppercorns, and dried currants.
ingredients: 3 (4 ounce) bars dark chocolate, chopped, divided

steps.text: Heat 2/3 of the dark chocolate in a microwave-safe bowl in 15-second intervals, stirring after each interval, until chocolate is nearly melted but some chunks remain, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from microwave and stir until completely smooth. Add the remaining 1/3 of dark chocolate. Stir well until all the chocolate has melted.

Lay out a large sheet of parchment paper on a flat work surface. Pour melted chocolate onto parchment and spread into a thin, even layer using a spatula. Scatter pink peppercorns, pistachios, and currants quickly over chocolate before it sets.
Leave the chocolate to set fully, about 45 minutes. Break into randomly sized pieces and store in an airtight container.

video.description: Watch how to make chocolate bark for Christmas 3 different ways by adding a variety of dried fruits and nuts. You can of course experiment as well and customize the recipe to your liking. A great treat for the whole family!
